|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Cell 2187 (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).
* '''Original''' ([[Cell 2187 (V)]], 22 June 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (23 June 2021). Players Committee card image, 22 June 2021: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-cell2187-original.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/cell_2187.png Holotable commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images”], no mark). Text: “If Leia imprisoned, deploy on table. [Set 8] Luke is a spy and stormtrooper. Han, Leia, and Luke are immune to Nevar Yalnal and Put All Sections On Alert. Once per turn, may ▼ a Death Star site. Immune to This Is Some Rescue! [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' (The release-day image of 23 June 2021 shows the same card.)
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 20 April 2022): Players Committee card image, 20 April 2022: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-cell2187-20220420.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d50/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/cell2187.png Holotable commit 2640d50 “Set 18 and errata”], no mark). Text: “If Leia imprisoned, deploy on table. [Set 8] Luke is a spy and stormtrooper. Han, Leia, and Luke are immune to Nevar Yalnal and Put All Sections On Alert. Once per turn, may ▼ a Death Star site. Immune to This Is Some Rescue! [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' the card was re-rendered at a higher resolution (745×1039, was 703×980); the words, layout and mark are unchanged. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
*: [[File:V15-L-cell2187-20220420-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Cell 2187 (V) (Errata 2)]], 11 December 2022): Players Committee card image, 11 December 2022: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-cell2187-E1-2022.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e9980f9/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/cell2187.png Holotable commit e9980f9 “Set 20 Errata, 2020 AIs, and a few fixes”], mark “E1”). Text: “If [Set 20] Leia imprisoned, deploy on table. [Set 8] Luke is a spy and stormtrooper. Chewie, Leia, and stormtroopers are immune to Nevar Yalnal, Physical Choke, and Put All Sections On Alert. Once per turn, may ▼ a Death Star site. Immune to This Is Some Rescue! [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' “If Leia imprisoned” became “If [Set 20] Leia imprisoned”; the immunity now covers “Chewie, Leia, and stormtroopers” (was “Han, Leia, and Luke”) and adds Physical Choke. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Cell 2187 (V) (Errata 3)]], 29 December 2024): Players Committee card image, 29 December 2024: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-cell2187.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/cell2187.png Holotable commit efc26cd “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”], mark “E2”). Text: “If [A New Hope] Leia imprisoned, deploy on table. [Set 8] Luke is a spy and stormtrooper. Chewie, Leia, and stormtroopers are immune to Nevar Yalnal, Physical Choke, and Put All Sections On Alert. Once per turn, may ▼ a blaster or rifle. Immune to This Is Some Rescue! [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' “[Set 20] Leia” became “[A New Hope] Leia”; “may ▼ a Death Star site” became “may ▼ a blaster or rifle”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E2”, but this is errata version 3 by release order (PC-E3); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
